review.meaning_summary: Macroscopic flexible hanging elements resting vertically under gravity in still air, showing settled contours without lateral wind deflection.
rejected_boundaries: ambient_particle is rejected because the source text specifies macroscopic flexible hanging elements such as ribbons or cloth resting vertically under gravity, not airborne particulate matter or suspended droplets, despite the routing tag.

atmospheric_medium is rejected because windless rest of hanging elements is governed by physical motion of materials, and atmospheric_medium explicitly excludes windless resting elements in favor of optical air scattering and medium states.
motion_rendering is rejected because the source specifies physical rest and absence of lateral deflection rather than image-plane capture blur, shutter trails, or optical freezing.
weather is rejected because the absence of wind deflection describes the physical rest of specific elements rather than an explicitly declared weather system.
